description: Reverse geocode (US geographies): Coordinates → state, county, place, metro area, census tract and block GEOIDs from the US Census Bureau Geocoder (free, no key). Source: US Census Bureau. Returns administrative geographies, not a street address; US only. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: in_us, state{name,fips,usps}, county, place, combined_statistical_area, urban_area, tract_geoid, block_geoid.
name: x420_geo_reverse-geocode
